text:
maria.chen: FYI customer StellarOps requested bring-up of firefly-13b-lite for Dedicated. They need <50ms p95 on short queries and quantized fp4 support. Any blockers?

devon: Got details? model format? hf or custom tar?

maria.chen: HF repo link: https://huggingface.co/stellarmodels/firefly-13b-lite -> they sent a tar with pytorch state dict. Customer will want FP4 quant and minimal accuracy loss (<2% on our eval set).

sasha: Assigning intake checklist: 1) model pull + convert -> onnx/ggml? 2) quant recipe smoke 3) perf run on 1xA10 4) regression eval vs redwood baseline

raj: I can take convert + quant smoke. Will try opt-quant pipeline. ETA today EOD. Any config suggestions?

maria.chen: Use quant profile 'lite-fp4-v2', set kv-cache shard=auto. For perf use seq_len=128 and batch=8 initial.

sasha: Add customer constraints: must avoid int8 fallback, needs deterministic sampling. Note on rollout: canary to 1% traffic then 10%.

raj: Starting conversion. command:
```
python convert.py --source hf --model firefly-13b-lite --out /tmp/firefly-fp4 --dtype fp4
```

infra-bot: Deploy request queued: job_id=job-7821, queued on pool=quant-smoke

devon: When you have the smoke logs paste them here. Also add sample prompts for eval.

raj: smoke result: token throughput ~210 t/s on a10x4, p95=62ms (seq128,batch8). Slight degradation vs our 13B baseline (p95 55ms). Starting eval now.

maria.chen: Good. Please run our 'summarization' prompt set and the 'toxicity' checks. Tag any >2% delta.

raj: Quick nudge: eval summary - rouge-l avg down 1.7%, toxicity unchanged. No hallucination spike.

sasha: Looks within threshold. Next: compatibility for Dedicated runtime (KV cache/pass-through). devex to prepare canary config.

devon: I'll draft canary config. Questions: do we need a fallback to 13B-quantized-v1? recommend yes.

maria.chen: Yes, automatic fallback to 13B-quantized-v1 on temp OOM or error.

sasha: ok. Action items: raj finalize artifact + upload to s3 (s3://redwood-inference/eng-ml/firefly-13b-lite/fp4/), devex prepare canary, infra schedule 1% canary next Tues. Closing intake unless regression shows up.

maria.chen: tagging @product-ops FYI for billing tier estimate.

devon: Thanks team :thumbsup:
